title: Rory and the Lantern Glade
verses:
The sun faded down past the top of the hill,
The valley was quiet and cozy and still.
Then Rory stepped out on the soft mossy ground,
And smiled as the night settled gently around.

Nia flew past through the cool evening air,
And called to her friends who were gathering there.
Psittaco nestled up high in a tree,
As happy and calm as a small bird could be.

Benny lay down with a peaceful deep sigh,
And looked at the stars glowing bright in the sky.
Tilly walked over to rest by his side,
Where ferns made a bed that was cozy and wide.

Ricky stopped bouncing and let out a yawn,
Content to just wait for the quiet of dawn.
The fireflies danced in a warm yellow light,
To softly guide everyone into the night.

Rory curled up on a pillow of green,
The happiest dreamer that ever was seen.
The leaves rustled low in a lullaby breeze,
That whispered bedtime right through all the trees.

The moon shone down bright with a comforting glow,
While all of the dinos breathed steady and slow.
So close your eyes now as the night softly gleams,
And join all the friends in a world full of dreams.
